mapper.update: /* QA 대상 선정 Batch (9060) */ /* QaTargetBatchMapper.resetQaUser */ /* 심사테이블의 QA선정 배치시 QA담당직원 배정 업데이트 */ UPDATE CSPD001TM SET QLAS_ALOC_DT = NULL, QLAS_PRG_YN = NULL, AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD = NULL, /* 자체점검시행 진행여부 */ QLAS_CRPE_ENO = NULL, /* QA담당자직원번호 */ AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD = NULL, /* QA액티비티코드, 자체점검시행 */ QLAS_SNPE_ENO = NULL, /* 품질보증결재자직원번호 */ LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstCd}, LST_DB_CHG_DTM = (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6') FROM DUAL) WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO IN ( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM WHERE QLAS_ALOC_DT = #{inptRcpDt} AND QLAS_ALOC_DT IS NOT NULL AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD = '110' GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO )
